## English

Palboo 1.1 brings English and Simplified Chinese across the App and a more complete, interactive product introduction.

### What's new

- **Choose your language.** Settings, workspace controls, edge and notch panels, and native dialogs now support English and Simplified Chinese. Switch languages in Appearance & Fonts while keeping your drafts and layout. Your own tasks, Bot names, directions, and glossary entries stay as you wrote them.
- **A continuous product tour.** The introduction connects the original PALBOO typing animation to the workspace. Scroll through features, sidebar and overlay layouts, moving to another display, edge positions, and materials in one continuous preview. You can take over the demos at any point; narrow screens and reduced-motion preferences use a simpler interactive presentation.
- **Clearer presentation in both languages.** The introduction has independent language and light/dark controls, improved English spacing, and larger touch targets. The README and installation instructions are available in both languages.

### Download

**`palboo-1.1.0-darwin-arm64.dmg`** contains the complete Palboo App for **macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon**. Open the DMG and drag Palboo to Applications. Existing settings and personal data are preserved.

Desktop windows require macOS 15 or later; native Liquid Glass requires macOS 26. See the [installation guide](https://github.com/0xTotoroX/palboo#installation) for setup and first-open help.

## 简体中文

Palboo 1.1 带来完整的中英文界面，以及更连贯、可操作的产品介绍。

### 更新内容

- **中英文切换。** 设置页、工作台控件、贴边／刘海面板和原生提示支持简体中文与 English。在「外观与字体」中切换语言，保留草稿和布局；个人任务、Bot 名称、自定义方向和词条保持原文。
- **连贯的产品演示。** 原版 PALBOO 打字动画接续到工作台，滚动即可依次浏览功能、侧栏与浮层、移到副屏、贴边位置和材质，沿用同一个预览框。随时可手动操作；窄屏与减少动态效果模式使用简化的交互展示。
- **更清晰的双语排版。** 介绍页提供独立语言和明暗切换，改善英文留白与触屏点击区域；README 和包内安装说明均提供中英文。

### 下载

**`palboo-1.1.0-darwin-arm64.dmg`** 内含完整 Palboo App，支持 **macOS 14 及以上的 Apple Silicon Mac**。打开 DMG，将 Palboo 拖入「应用程序」，保留已有设置和个人数据。

桌面窗口需要 macOS 15 及以上，原生液态材质需要 macOS 26。配置与首次打开帮助见[安装指南](https://github.com/0xTotoroX/palboo/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md#安装)。
